name: leapware-watchtower
description: LEAPWare's own single-plugin marketplace. Hosts LW-WATCHTOWER, the governance, monitoring and health layer applied to every Claude Code session.

plugins.name: lw-watchtower
plugins.description: WINDOWS ONLY. Requires Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe); all thirteen hook registrations invoke it by that name. A Claude Code governance layer that refuses to overstate itself. Ten modules OBSERVE and block nothing: failure capture and healing, end-of-turn advisories for context pressure, unverified work, docs coupling, git hygiene and mission drift, self-health, log rotation, a session banner and status line, and per-dispatch context injection for subagents. A tenth, delegate_gate, is the ONE thing here that can refuse a tool call - a PreToolUse hook that blocks Edit, Write, NotebookEdit, Bash and PowerShell on the main thread so all work goes to subagents - and it SHIPS SWITCHED OFF. The destructive-command and secret-scanning gates were removed on 30 July 2026 at the owner's instruction and are not coming back: nothing here inspects a shell command, a path or a credential, and setup installs no permissions.deny rules.
